'And in the second year of this week in this jubilee, Rebecca called Jacob her son, and spake unto him, saying: my son, do not take thee a wife of the daughters of Canaan, as Esau, thy brother, who took him two wives of the daughters of Canaan' — Rebekah's command parallels but precedes Isaac's command of Jub 25:5 + Gen 28:1. The Tewahedo Marian liturgy (Wǝddase Maryam) draws on this maternal-spiritual-authority pattern for the elevation of Mary's intercessory role.
